verdict.rationale: Anthropic's pricing page mentions 'Hand off and schedule tasks' as a Claude.ai feature, and the platform offers Managed Agents for long-running async work plus a Batches API for async processing, but none of the docs explicitly describe recurring/cron-style scheduled workflows or a scheduling API. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a recurring/cron scheduling mechanism, API-level scheduling parameters, and independent confirmation of the 'schedule tasks' feature's actual recurrence capability.
